scene: The brass lens reveals distant landmarks across the sunny, shimmering city.
picture: Through the circular brass telescope frame, three city transit points are visible side by side. On the far left, a glass-bottomed boat bobs at a sunlit pier. In the centre, a yellow hillside chairlift sways at its base station. On the far right, a red sleigh tram rests on frost rails.
shown: a glass-bottomed tour boat moored at a wooden pier on the far left
a yellow hillside chairlift swing rocking gently at its station in the centre
a red sleigh tram waiting on polished frost rails on the far right
